sn10.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Ṭaṅkitamañce Suciloma-yakkhassa bhavane || || 2.
sn10.3:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Kharo ca yakkho Sucilomo ca yakkho Bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti || || 3.
sn10.3:1.3: Atha kho Kharo yakkho Sucilomaṃ yakkham etad avoca || ||
sn10.3:1.6: yāva jānāmi yadi vā so samaṇo yadi vā pana so samaṇako ti || || 5.
sn10.3:2.1: Atha kho Sucilomo yakkho yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato kāyam upanāmesi || || 6.
sn10.3:2.3: Atha kho Sucilomo yakkho Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn10.3:2.6: api ca te samphasso pāpako ti || || 9.
sn10.3:2.8: sace me na vyākarissasi || cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi hadayaṃ vā te phālessāmi || pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipissāmī ti || || 10.
sn10.3:2.9: Na khvāhaṃ taṃ āvuso passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sa devamanussāya yo me cittaṃ va khipeyya hadayaṃ vā phāleyya || pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipeyya ||
sn10.3:2.10: api ca tvam āvuso puccha yad ākaṅkhasī ti || || 11.
sn10.3:3.1: Rāgo ca doso ca kuto nidānā ||
sn10.3:4.1: Rāgo ca doso ca ito nidānā ||
